specification.title: Pearson Edexcel Level 1/Level 2 GCSE (9-1) in Mathematics

notes: Structure and content references (N1 to S6) follow the board's published specification. Topic titles are short summaries written for RevisionDen, not specification text. All references are assessed at Higher tier.

Gradients and intercepts of linear functions
Roots and turning points of quadratics
Gradients of and areas under graphs
Equation of a circle and tangents
Forming and solving equations from situations
nth term of linear and quadratic sequences
